about.hero.title: Building a Bridge of Trust Between Customers and Rental Companies
about.hero.subtitle: Yalla Car is a Jordanian platform that brings together the best car rental companies in one place, with a simple and transparent Arabic booking experience
about.story.title: We Started from a Real Problem
about.story.p1: We noticed that tourists and residents in Jordan face significant difficulty finding a suitable car: foreign websites, unclear prices, hidden fees, and negative experiences with untrustworthy companies.
about.story.p2: On the other hand, small and medium local rental companies suffer from weak digital presence and difficulty reaching customers directly. So the idea was born: to build a fair Arabic platform for both parties.
about.story.p3: Today, Yalla Car brings together licensed companies, showcases their cars with real photos and clear prices, and enables direct booking without intermediaries or hidden fees.
about.vision.title: Our Vision
about.vision.text: To be the leading car rental platform in Jordan and the region, known for transparency, trust, and an Arabic user experience.
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.text: Empowering local rental companies to reach their customers, and providing a smooth and secure booking experience for customers at fair and clear prices.
about.values.title: Our Core Values
about.values.transparencyDesc: The final price is clear before payment, with no hidden fees or surprises.
about.values.trustDesc: Every partner company is licensed, and every experience is documented with photos and reviews.
about.values.speedDesc: Booking confirmed within minutes via WhatsApp, with no complicated procedures.
about.values.localDesc: We know the Jordanian market, and we design an experience that suits the local customer's culture.
about.cta.title: Ready to Join Us?
about.cta.text: Whether you're a customer looking for a car, or a rental company wanting to increase bookings — we're here to help.

contact.faq.title: Quick Questions
contact.faq.q1: How long does it take to get a response?
contact.faq.a1: Our team usually responds within 24 hours maximum. For urgent cases, contact us via WhatsApp.
contact.faq.q2: How do I register my company?
contact.faq.a2: Go to the "Register Company" page, fill the form and attach the required documents. Our team will review your request within 48 hours.
contact.faq.a3: Yes, you can cancel the booking from the "My Bookings" page. The cancellation policy depends on the timing and the company's terms.
faq.hero.title: How can we help?
faq.hero.subtitle: Search the FAQ, or contact us directly if you can't find an answer
faq.q.booking1: How do I book a car on the site?
faq.a.booking1: Choose the city and pickup/return dates from the homepage, click "Search", then choose the car and click "Book Now". You'll need to fill your details and confirm the booking.
faq.q.booking2: What are the requirements to book?
faq.a.booking2: Minimum age is 21, a valid driving license held for at least one year, and an ID or passport. Some companies may require an older age for certain car categories.
faq.q.booking3: How long does it take to confirm a booking?
faq.a.booking3: Bookings are usually confirmed within a maximum of 15 minutes. You'll receive a WhatsApp message with the booking confirmation and pickup details.
faq.q.booking4: Can I choose a specific car with photos?
faq.a.booking4: Yes, every car is displayed with real photos of its specific model and year. You won't get an "equivalent car" but the exact same car as in the photos.
faq.a.payment1: We offer three methods: CliQ (Jordanian instant payment), credit cards, and cash on pickup. All options are clearly stated on the booking page.
faq.a.payment2: No. Our policy is "Honest Price" — the final total is clear before payment, including rental, insurance, deposit, and allowed mileage. No surprises at pickup.
faq.a.payment3: The deposit is refunded within 3-7 business days from the car return date, after confirming no damage or violations. The amount and return date are documented in the booking page.
faq.a.cancel1: Yes, you can cancel from the "My Bookings" page. Cancellation more than 48 hours before pickup is completely free. Closer cancellations may incur a small fee.
faq.q.cancel2: How do I change the booking dates?
faq.a.cancel2: Contact us via WhatsApp or from the "My Bookings" page — we'll help you change the dates based on car availability. Changes more than 24 hours before are usually free.
faq.q.companies1: How do I register my company on Yalla Car?
faq.a.companies1: Go to the "Register Company" page, fill in your company details and upload documents (commercial registration and tax certificate). Our team will review your request within 48 hours.
faq.a.companies2: Commission starts at 8% per confirmed booking. No listing fees — you only pay when you get an actual booking. No risk, no capital required.
faq.q.companies3: Is there a monthly subscription fee?
faq.a.companies3: No, listing is completely free. We also offer an optional SaaS plan (15-30 JOD/month) with advanced car and contract management features, but it's not mandatory.
faq.q.safety1: How do you ensure companies are trustworthy?
faq.a.safety1: Every partner company must provide its commercial registration and municipal license. We manually verify documents before approval and give the company a "Verified" badge.
faq.q.safety2: What if the car is damaged?
faq.a.safety2: All cars are fully insured. At pickup and return, we photograph the car completely and save the photos in the booking. This protects both parties from any dispute.
faq.q.safety3: Is my data safe on the platform?
faq.a.safety3: Yes. We use SSL encryption, and we don't share your data with any third party. Payment data is processed through certified payment gateways (PayTabs / CliQ).

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using the Yalla Car platform
terms.s1.title: Introduction
terms.s1.p1: Welcome to Yalla Car ("the Platform", "we", "the Site"). Yalla Car is an intermediary electronic platform that connects licensed car rental companies in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan with customers looking to rent cars.
terms.s1.p2: These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") set the rules governing your use of the Platform and its services. By using the Platform, you agree to these Terms in full.
terms.s1.note: Yalla Car is an intermediary platform only. The actual rental contract is concluded directly between the customer and the rental company.
terms.s2.title: Acceptance of Terms
terms.s2.p1: By using the Platform in any way (browsing, registering, booking, or any other activity), you:
terms.s2.li1: Confirm that you have read and fully understood these Terms
terms.s2.li2: Agree to comply with all its provisions without exception
terms.s2.li3: Undertake to provide accurate and correct information when registering
terms.s2.li4: Confirm that you are at least 18 years old
terms.s2.p2: If you do not agree with any provision of these Terms, you must immediately stop using the Platform.
terms.s3.title: Registration & Account
terms.s3.p1: To use some Platform services (such as booking or company registration), you must create an account. You are responsible for:
terms.s3.li1: The accuracy and correctness of the information provided
terms.s3.li2: Maintaining the confidentiality of your password
terms.s3.li3: All activities carried out through your account
terms.s3.li4: Notifying us immediately upon discovering any unauthorized use
terms.s3.p2: We reserve the right to suspend or delete any account that violates these Terms or engages in suspicious activity, without prior notice.
terms.s4.title: Booking & Payment
terms.s4.p1: When completing a booking through the Platform:
terms.s4.li1: The final comprehensive price (rental + insurance + deposit) is displayed before payment
terms.s4.li2: The booking is confirmed within a maximum of 15 minutes via WhatsApp
terms.s4.li3: The deposit is paid through the Platform and refunded within 3-7 business days from the return date
terms.s4.li4: The booking may be subject to the rental company's conditions (age, license, etc.)
terms.s4.note: "Honest Price" is our core commitment: no hidden fees, no surprises at pickup.
terms.s5.title: Cancellation & Refund
terms.s5.p1: Cancellations are subject to the following policy:
terms.s5.p2: The policy may vary depending on the rental company, and you will be notified of the details before confirming the booking.
terms.s6.title: User Responsibilities
terms.s6.li1: Use the rented car only for legitimate purposes
terms.s6.li2: Not sublease the car or transfer it to a third party
terms.s6.li3: Not use the car for illegal activities, races, or driving lessons
terms.s6.li5: Return the car in the same condition it was received
terms.s7.title: Company Responsibilities
terms.s7.p1: Companies registered on the Platform undertake to:
terms.s7.li1: Provide valid documents (commercial registration + municipal license)
terms.s7.li2: Keep their cars in good technical and safety condition
terms.s7.li3: Comply with the price displayed on the Platform
terms.s7.li4: Deliver the specific car shown in photos (not an "equivalent car")
terms.s7.p2: We reserve the right to remove any company that violates these commitments from the Platform.
terms.s8.title: Intellectual Property
terms.s8.p1: All Platform content — including text, logos, images, designs, and software — is exclusively owned by Yalla Car and is protected by Jordanian and international intellectual property laws.
terms.s8.p2: Copying, reusing, or distributing any Platform content without prior written permission is prohibited.
terms.s9.title: Amendments to Terms
terms.s9.p1: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. You will be notified of material changes via:
terms.s9.li1: A message on the registered email address
terms.s9.li3: Updating the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page
terms.s9.p2: Your continued use of the Platform after the amendments means your acceptance of them.
terms.s10.title: Governing Law
terms.s10.p1: These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan. Any dispute arising from the use of the Platform shall be resolved before the competent Jordanian courts.
terms.s10.p2: For any inquiry regarding these Terms, contact us via the "Contact Us" page or at: legal@yallacar.jo
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We are committed to protecting your privacy and keeping your personal data safe
privacy.s1.title: Introduction
privacy.s1.p1: At Yalla Car, we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use the Platform.
privacy.s1.p2: By using the Platform, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
privacy.s2.title: Data We Collect
privacy.s2.p1: We collect the following types of data:
privacy.s2.li7: Payment details (we do not store card data)
privacy.s2.li10: Pages you visited on the Platform
privacy.s3.title: How We Use Your Data
privacy.s3.p1: We use your data for the following purposes:
privacy.s3.li2: Communicating with you regarding your bookings
privacy.s3.li3: Improving user experience on the Platform
privacy.s3.note: We do not sell your data to any third party, and we do not use it for marketing purposes without your explicit consent.
privacy.s4.title: Data Sharing
privacy.s4.p1: We only share your data with:
privacy.s4.li1: The rental company — only what is needed to complete the booking (name, phone number)
privacy.s4.li2: Payment gateways — to process transactions (PayTabs / CliQ)
privacy.s4.li3: Legal authorities — only upon official request
privacy.s4.p2: We do not share your data with any other party without your consent.
privacy.s5.title: Data Protection
privacy.s5.p1: We take strict security measures to protect your data:
privacy.s5.li5: Not storing bank card data on our servers
privacy.s6.title: Cookies
privacy.s6.p1: We use cookies for the following purposes:
privacy.s6.li3: Analyzing Platform usage to improve it
privacy.s6.p2: You can disable cookies from your browser settings, but this may affect some functions.
privacy.s7.title: Your Rights
privacy.s7.li1: Access your personal data stored with us
privacy.s7.li3: Request deletion of your account and data
privacy.s7.li4: Object to the processing of your data for marketing purposes
privacy.s7.li5: File a complaint with a data protection authority
privacy.s7.p2: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at: privacy@yallacar.jo
privacy.s8.title: Policy Amendments
privacy.s8.p1: We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal reasons. You will be notified of material changes via email.
privacy.s9.title: Contact Us
privacy.s9.p1: For any question or inquiry about the privacy policy or the processing of your data, contact us:
privacy.cta.title: Your Privacy is Our Priority
privacy.cta.text: For any inquiry about your data, we're here to help
